semanticReview.claim: A zero at any fixed probe position safely rejects a correctly maintained membership summary; all one bits mean only possible presence.
sources: R3 Strategy.mightContain contract and strategy loops
semanticReview.review: Supported. The code sets selected bits and returns false on its first unset probe; code and Javadoc use the same mapping for insertion/query.

semanticReview.claim: More space can reduce false-positive risk for a chosen capacity; bounded teaching fixtures do not determine a production error rate.
sources: R1 Total size of a Bloom filter
semanticReview.review: Supported as a configuration tradeoff. No product defaults, memory multiples, or the document's simplified positive-answer denominator are adopted.

semanticReview.claim: Wrong bit clearing can create false negatives; an unsynchronized external catalog cannot be safely gated by stale marks.
sources: R3 stable Strategy and funnel requirements
semanticReview.review: These are explicit deductions/witnesses from the set-bit model, not claims that an official source specifies this episode's maintenance protocol.

semanticReview.claim: The episode's 16-bit SHA-256 teaching mapping is distinct from product implementations.
semanticReview.review: Correctly separated. Guava derives probes from Murmur hashes; the teaching SHA mapping does not purport to reproduce Guava or Redis internals.
